'''Piggie and the Orbiting Nasties''' was a [[Tarasin]] band. Its name came from an off-hand description of the [[Metatheran Cartel]] that was made by a reporter. The band was made up of Tarasin from the [[Buraka irstat]], including [[Nyronusa]]. They hated the Cartel, as they held it responsible for the destruction of a [[Ch'hala tree]] grove that they had been tasked with protecting. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they performed at a party held by the Cartel on [[Dorumaa]], where they hoped to gain revenge. They wore [[Caarite]] masks while they performed.

The band played Tarasin-style music, which was popular with their own species, but not with many others.
